text.tspan: List is fully sorted in ascending order!

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Insertion sort takes each item and inserts it into its place in the sorted prefix.
Time: O(n) best for nearly sorted, O(n^2) worst case. Stable and in-place.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Each new item is inserted into the sorted part; larger items slide right to make a gap.
